title: SQL Injection – Login Bypass
impact: allows unauthorized access to an account
remediation: Use parameterized SQL queries and properly validate user input.

title: SQL Injection - User Data Dump via Product Search (UNION)
column17: Extracts every user's email address and password hash through the product search endpoint
column19: Use parameterized queries and a least-privilege database account; validate input and do not interpolate it into SQL.

title: Reflected XSS via Search Query
impact: Runs attacker-supplied JavaScript in a victim's browser from a crafted search link
remediation: enabling session/cookie theft and actions performed as the victim.
column12: avoid rendering untrusted input via innerHTML/bypassSecurityTrustHtml and enforce a strict Content-Security-Policy.

title: Stored XSS via User Email Rendered on Admin Page
impact: A malicious email stored through the registration API executes in the administrator's browser when the user-management page is opened
